statement: For every d>=1 and every z>0, smooth strictly positive densities p,q on R^d with q log-concave and finite H(p|q) and I(p|q) satisfy 2[H(p|q)-H(p*gamma_z|q*gamma_z)] <= integral_0^z E_p|E_p[grad log(p/q)(Y)|Y+sqrt(r)G]|^2 dr.

structural_extension.statement: The finite-copy proof tolerates arbitrary adaptive discarded projections containing the posterior-mean difference with ranks ell_N=o(N).
structural_extension.uniform_error: E|P_i g_i|^2 <= N inf_{K>0}[ell_N K/N + 2 E_p(|w|^2 1_{|w|^2>K/2})], uniformly over every observation mesh.

strictness_construction.relative_entropy: finite by the explicit linear log-ratio majorant
